main:1.text: Hell on Earth is the second novel of the novelization series written by Dafydd ab Hugh and Brad Linaweaver. They were creatures seemingly spawned straight from the pits of Hell—demons, zombies, fire-breathing imps—all too horrifically close to the stuff of nightmare to be real. But they were.

main:2.text: Exultia is the second level of the campaign in Doom Eternal. The first part (about one-third) takes place on Argent D'Nur in the city of Exultia, while the rest takes place in Hell. With the other two Hell Priests having gone into hiding following the demise of Deag Nilox, VEGA informs the Doom Slayer that he will need to rebuild the Celestial Locator in order to locate them.

main:3.text: Cultist Base, also known as the "Cursed Citadel," is an Arctic facility that was owned by the UAC that Deag Ranak took over to build his Doom Hunters. It serves as the third level of Doom Eternal. The UAC Cultists operate from a remote facility located in the Arctic tundra of Greenland.

main:4.text: Doom Hunter Base is the fourth level of the campaign in Doom Eternal, and follows consecutively after the previous level, Cultist Base. In this level you will face Doom Hunters as a boss fight. This level does not have a Sentinel Gate or Secret Encounters. After a tram ride, the Slayer continues his pursuit of Deag Ranak, fighting his way past more demons and cultist-zombies.

main:5.text: Super Gore Nest is the fifth level of the campaign in Doom Eternal. It is a ruined-urban level much like the first mission, but in an advanced state of hellification. With the elimination of Deag Ranak, only one Hell Priest remains. As you prepare for the final encounter with the remaining Priest, your plans are interrupted by the Khan Maykr.

main:6.text: ARC Complex is the sixth level of the campaign in Doom Eternal. At the end you face a Marauder as a mini-boss fight. It doesn't count as an official boss fight so the level does contain a Slayer Gate and Secret Encounters. The final Field Drone is also found in this level. Having destroyed the Super Gore Nest, the hunt for the remaining Hell Priest continues.

main:7.text: Mars Core is the seventh level of the campaign in Doom Eternal. It is one of the more visually impressive levels, taking place in low Mars orbit, ending at a partly Hellified site on the surface of Mars. The last Runes in the game are found on this level. With the help of Samuel Hayden, the final Hell Priest has been located on Sentinel Prime - a city from your past.

main:8.text: Sentinel Prime is the eighth level of the campaign in Doom Eternal. In it there are pickups detailing the story of Argent D'Nur and the Slayer as he fought with them against the demons. At the end there is the Gladiator as a boss fight. There is no Slayer Gate or Secret Encounters in this level. This level is also unique in the game for not containing any battles at all except for the boss fight.

main:9.text: Taras Nabad is the ninth level of the campaign in Doom Eternal. It is the third Argenta level after Exultia and Sentinel Prime. The last Slayer Gate is in this level, and Mastery Tokens are also introduced here for the first time. Swimming is introduced in this level, as the Slayer explores Taras Nabad's sewer system.

main:10.text: Nekravol is the tenth campaign level in Doom Eternal. Even though the Slayer Gates are all done, there are still Secret Encounters. Nekravol is a city in Hell of indeterminately ancient origin. The area surrounding it abounds with lava, ruins, and brimstone. At the core, and perhaps the reason for the area's "development" is the Citadel, a monumental Soul Spire, and the largest of many within the city.

main:11.text: Nekravol Part 2 is the eleventh level of the campaign in Doom Eternal. The last Sentinel Crystal is found in this level. As you make your ascent, you approach the final floors of the Citadel where souls are extracted from their bodies and converted into Argent Energy.

main:12.text: Urdak is the twelfth level of the campaign in Doom Eternal. At the end is another boss fight, where the Slayer must confront the Khan Maykr herself. The final albums, cheat code, and toy collectables are also found in this level. Nekravol's energy conduit has transported you to Urdak, homeworld of the Khan Maykr. The souls of Earth's victims flow here, converted into a source of energy for a dying species.

main:13.text: Final Sin is the thirteenth and final mission of the main campaign in Doom Eternal. It is the fourth urban level. Notably, there are almost no exploration pickups except for one codex page, but there are other pickups such as Crucible charges, BFG-9000/Unmaykr cells, and extra lives. 'For he will walk among us, and he will smite the evil from this earth.
